title: ForeverWEATHER
tag_line: Rain puddles & droplets: wet roads with reflections, drops on cars, glass and lens, hydroplaning.
message:
[B]Made with AI[/B]: this mod was written by an AI assistant (Claude, by Anthropic, working in Claude Code): all of its code, shaders, settings panel and texts. I directed the work, tested it in game and chose what stays.

[B]Requirements[/B]: BeamNG.drive 0.40.x with DX12 or Vulkan. DX11 doesn't support SSR in BeamNG.drive currently, and the puddles use it. No other mod is needed.

[B]What it does[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Wet asphalt that darkens and turns glossy with the rain, and puddles on the roads with screen-space reflections, rain ripples and tyre wakes. Water only stands on level ground: no puddles on hills.
[*]Drops on every nearby car: round beads, teardrops and elongated running drops. They bead, run off with gravity and stream back with the airflow, and each one is a small lens.
[*]Rain on your car's windshield, rear and side windows, from the seat and from outside, cleared by automatic rain-sensing wipers. The drops on the glass are lenses like the ones on the paint. Works together with the "Animated Wipers" mod if you have it (optional; nothing of it is included or changed): the rain sensor uses that mod's own wiper switch.
[*]Drops on the camera lens all over the screen, blown toward the edges as you drive.
[*]Node-based hydroplaning (Arcade / Simcade / Sim): the water under each tyre's contact patch lifts it off the road against the tyre's own pressure, from exactly the puddles you see.
[*]Its own falling rain on the graphics card (BeamNG's particle rain costs about 4 ms of CPU time per frame in heavy rain), tyre spray, and dry ground, glass and cars under tunnels, bridges and roofs.
[*]The ground gets wet and dries over time. It can follow the game's own weather, and on the BeamNG.Earth map that map's real weather.
[/LIST]
Settings: Pause menu > Mods > ForeverWEATHER. Not sure what to tune? Use the Quick look buttons (Damp / Wet / Storm / Flooded) at the top. Console: extensions.rainPuddles.openUI()

[B]1.4.0 changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Leaner: the stylized extras are gone, the realistic rain stays.
[*]Midnight is gone: the night street-racer look (film grade, vignette, haze, lamp halos, the clock held at midnight) and its Quick look button.
[*]Random mood is gone (the button and 'A random mood on every map').
[*]The street-lamp boost is gone: no extra lamp highlights painted on the wet road and no lamp sparks in the drops. At night the road and the drops show the light the game draws.
[*]Everything else stays. Your settings stay; the removed ones are dropped from the settings file.
[/LIST]

[B]1.3.1 changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Tyre spray at night is lit by the lights around it, in their colour: street lamps, headlights and the car's own tail lights, so the spray behind a car glows red at night and flares up when it brakes. By day nothing changes; in an unlit street it barely shows, as in reality.
[*]Windshield drops seen from outside (chase and showcase views) show as distinct specks catching the sky by day and the lamps at night, at the glass's real wet coverage. The windshield is also found from outside now, so cars you never sat in get drops on their glass too.
[/LIST]

[B]1.3.0 changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Windshield and window drops use the body drops' optics 1:1: refraction (each drop shows a small, upside-down image of the world around it), Fresnel on the same scale (default 0.12, it was 1.0) and Light catch. No more bubbles by day: the fixed white highlight, the milky veil and the wide dark ring are gone. From the seat a drop has the thin dark outline of real water.
[*]Light catch at night: the 8 nearest street lamps make tiny, sharp sparks in the drops. From the seat the windshield glitters under street lights; beads on the paint sparkle. Mostly white and about a pixel in size, so the lamps never tint the beads. New slider: Glass drops: light catch.
[*]Puddles: Reflectivity keeps the angle. Water is nearly clear looking straight down and a mirror toward the horizon (at the default the puddles right in front of you mirror 6 % instead of 15 %).
[*]Light streaks: street lamps on rough wet asphalt stretch into long streaks toward you (up to 5x at low angles); deep puddles keep a sharp mirror image.
[*]Fixes: no pass can write a broken (NaN) pixel any more, which the game's anti-aliasing could spread into black flicker on cars and in the cabin; a softer in-car mask edge; the sky behind the windshield; wipers after a vehicle reset (with Animated Wipers); hydroplaning and lens-drop edge cases.
[*]Your settings stay; untouched old glass defaults move to the new ones.
[/LIST]

[B]1.2.1 changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]New: Light catch for the drops on the cars. Where a bead mirrors something far brighter than the paint (the sky over a dark car, lit streets and street lamps at night), its rim catches the light, so the drops show in the dark. Beads on mid and light paint by day stay clear lenses. It only brightens the rims, never tints them.
[/LIST]

[B]1.2.0 changes[/B]
[LIST]
[*]Renamed: the zip is ForeverWEATHER.zip now (remove the old rainPuddles.zip). The mod manager shows its icon and description. Your settings stay.
[*]Drops on the cars are clear water instead of bubbles: Fresnel 0.12 (was 1.0, which turned every bead's rim into a mirror), refraction 1.75 (was 1.0, slider up to 2.5).
[*]The street lamps no longer colour the beads (the lamp sparkles and glowing rims of 1.1 are gone).
[*]New droplet shape: the elongated teardrop, a slim line that swells into a small round head, for the drops running over the car (most of them at speed).
[*]Glass drops (windshield, rear and side windows) have their own Refraction and Fresnel sliders.
[*]Lens drops land all over the screen, also in the middle, and drift to the edges more gently. Round, with a slight hint of a teardrop.
[*]No puddles on slopes: they fade out between 3 % and 5 % grade (new slider: Steepest ground for puddles). The slope comes from the road's real shape, and hydroplaning uses the same limit.
[*]From 1.1.1: puddles and the wet ground reach further (up to 600 m and 800 m), up to 24 street lamps light the wet road, and Midnight keeps every light's own colour.
[/LIST]

[B]Known issues[/B]
[LIST]
[*]A black flicker on cars or in the cabin was reported but could not be reproduced; 1.3.0 fixes its likely causes. If you still see it, please report when (camera, weather, time of day).
[*]Puddles may still appear on cars beyond the 12 nearest, or on static (non-driveable) car props.
[*]Windshield, rear and side-window rain is drawn on your own car only. Each side's windows are one flat pane, so on strongly curved side glass the drops can sit a little off the glass.
[*]Without Animated Wipers, a blade's pivot can be mistaken for its tip on some wiper meshes, so that blade clears the wrong part of the glass.
[*]Hydroplaning does not see the tyre wakes (the water a car ahead pushed aside) except for a car's own front-to-rear track. Tyres are recognised by part name.
[*]The default reflection traces are the longest and thickest ones: on a slower graphics card lower 'Trace steps' (puddles and wet road) first.
[*]Roofs are sampled every 4 m around the camera: rain can fall a little past the edge of a roof, and the dry ground under a bridge has soft edges.
[*]With 'Follow the game's weather' on, the game's own particle rain falls as well as this mod's.
[*]Modded cars whose glass meshes are not named like the official ones fall back to the jbeam windshield frame and get no rear-glass drops.
[/LIST]
